title: Headless WordPress: stripping the REST API payload for Next.js
angle: WordPress sends too much data by default. This covers how to intercept and strip the REST API response down to only the fields a Next.js frontend actually consumes, paired with an edge caching middleware pattern to fix TTFB.
whyItFits: Shows he knows how to take a notoriously heavy CMS and force it to perform at enterprise standards.

title: HubSpot Themes: building components that marketers cannot break
angle: A component architecture approach to HubSpot that limits style overrides while preserving layout flexibility. Explains how to use custom modules and strict field definitions to enforce brand guidelines automatically.
whyItFits: Proves he builds for the actual end users while maintaining strict engineering rigor.

title: Model Routing: dynamically selecting LLMs in a Next.js marketing stack
angle: Relying on a single LLM provider for all features is a failure point. A technical look at how to route tasks dynamically between Claude, OpenAI, and local models based on latency requirements and token costs.
whyItFits: Demonstrates deep practical experience with AI integration beyond basic API wrappers.

title: Vercel AI SDK Core: how tool calling and streaming actually work
angle: A technical breakdown of how the AI SDK handles streaming responses and tool calling under the hood. Focuses on the adapter pattern they use to normalize different provider APIs into a single interface.
whyItFits: Positions him as an engineer who reads the source code of the tools he uses and understands their architectural decisions.

title: Sanity Schema Patterns: building page builders without the maintenance debt
angle: How to structure Sanity schemas using polymorphic arrays for a flexible page builder that avoids becoming a maintenance nightmare. Covers validation rules and preview configurations for complex layouts.
whyItFits: Highlights his ability to architect CMS solutions that balance content flexibility with structured data.

title: Microinteractions: measuring the actual engineering cost of animation
angle: A framework for evaluating when a complex animation is worth the bundle size and main thread blocking time. Details specific profiling techniques in Chrome DevTools to measure the exact performance impact on Core Web Vitals.
whyItFits: Shows he cares about design but grounds his decisions in measurable performance metrics and user experience.

title: Visual Builders: the false economy of no code workarounds
angle: Trying to force Webflow to handle complex conditional logic always costs more engineering time than building a custom React application. A technical guide on when to eject from visual builders and own the stack.
whyItFits: Proves he can make strategic technical decisions and knows the hard limits of different platform types.

title: Core Web Vitals: treating LCP as a demand generation metric
angle: The direct correlation between LCP improvements and form submission rates on B2B landing pages. Shares a case study of optimizing a Next.js site to drop render blocking resources and the resulting conversion lift.
whyItFits: Connects engineering outcomes directly to business metrics that matter to marketing leadership.

title: Webflow Client API: the undocumented endpoints for programmatic updates
angle: A practical look at the undocumented endpoints in the Webflow API that allow for programmatic site updates. Explains how to use them for automated content syncing from external databases.
whyItFits: Shows he digs deep into platform capabilities to build integrations that most people assume are impossible.

title: Content Migration: multi agent orchestration for unstructured data
angle: How to use a network of Claude Code agents to parse, structure, and migrate thousands of unstructured blog posts into a new headless CMS format. Covers the prompt architecture and validation steps.
whyItFits: Demonstrates advanced AI workflow automation for a painful and common marketing engineering task.

title: Marketo Forms: decoupling submission logic from the client library
angle: How to build custom React forms that post directly to the Marketo background endpoint. Eliminates the need to load the heavy Marketo JavaScript library on the client entirely.
whyItFits: Addresses a specific and universal pain point for marketing engineers with a clean technical solution.

title: Tailwind CSS v4: analyzing the new CSS variable engine architecture
angle: An analysis of the new engine architecture in Tailwind v4. Focuses on the CSS variable approach and what it actually means for design system implementations in enterprise codebases.
whyItFits: Shows he stays ahead of core tooling changes and evaluates them based on architectural impact.

title: Component APIs: designing React props for marketing teams
angle: How to structure React component props so that non technical users can assemble pages in a visual editor without creating broken layouts. Covers default values, prop validation, and error boundaries.
whyItFits: Highlights his expertise in bridging the gap between engineering systems and marketing workflows.

title: Sanity vs Webflow: a technical rubric for platform selection
angle: A technical rubric for deciding between a headless CMS and a visual builder based on content relationships, localization requirements, and available engineering resources.
whyItFits: Positions him as a strategic partner who can guide platform selection instead of just executing tickets.

title: AI Native Workflows: delegating boilerplate to Codex and architecture to Claude
angle: A breakdown of a daily workflow using multiple AI assistants for different tasks. Explains the reasoning behind using Codex for boilerplate generation and Claude for architectural refactoring.
whyItFits: Shows he is an efficient and modern engineer who uses AI to accelerate output without compromising quality.

title: Next.js App Router: overriding default caching semantics for marketing content
angle: A clear explanation of how the App Router handles caching by default and how to override it for dynamic marketing content. A necessary reference for anyone building headless architectures.
whyItFits: Proves his mastery of a complex and critical tool in the modern frontend stack.

title: Localization Workflows: syncing headless CMS content with translation APIs
angle: How to connect a headless CMS to a translation API and a Git based approval process. Details the webhooks and edge functions required to keep multiple regions in sync without manual data entry.
whyItFits: Demonstrates experience building enterprise scale marketing infrastructure.

title: Edge Functions: personalizing static pages without layout shift
angle: A technical deep dive into using Vercel Edge Middleware to inject localized pricing and user context into statically generated Next.js pages before they hit the browser.
whyItFits: Solves a classic marketing web problem of balancing static site performance with dynamic personalization.

title: Figma Variables: automating design token synchronization
angle: How to set up a GitHub Action that pulls updated color and typography variables directly from the Figma API and compiles them into CSS custom properties.
whyItFits: Proves he can build internal tooling that aligns engineering and design teams.

title: Claude Code: building a local plugin for marketing operations
angle: An overview of writing a custom Claude Code plugin that can directly query a Marketo instance and draft landing page copy based on past successful campaigns.
whyItFits: Positions him at the frontier of AI tooling for practical marketing workflows.
